en: Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a narrow cobbled street flanked by low townhouses leading to a tall church with a slender spire and cross on top. A few pedestrians stand near the church entrance. Printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Church of Saint Anne in Bruges and includes publisher information. There is also some red handwritten text near the bottom.
